# A-Shine Auto Mobile Detailing

> A-Shine Auto Mobile Detailing is a 5.0★ rated mobile interior car detailing and deep steam sanitization service based in Kitchener-Waterloo, Ontario, Canada.
> Website: https://www.a-shineautomobiledetailing.ca/

## Overview
A-Shine Auto Mobile Detailing brings full-service interior car cleaning directly to client driveways, parking spaces, and job sites across Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, and Guelph. Studio drop-off is also available at 54 Woodbine Avenue, Kitchener, ON. The company specializes in deep upholstery shampooing, thermal steam sanitization, winter road salt extraction, stubborn stain removal, and commercial truck cab detailing. Fully insured with 8+ years of detailing experience.

## Transparent Flat-Rate Pricing
- Small Car (Sedans, Coupes & Hatchbacks): $100 CAD Flat Rate
  Includes: Full seat shampooing & stain removal, deep carpet steam extraction, salt removal, dashboard, console, vents, door jambs, trunk clean, and odor treatment.
- SUV (5-Seater Crossovers & Pickups): $125 CAD Flat Rate
  Includes: Deep seat shampooing, carpet extraction, console, cup holders, door jambs, cargo area, full steam sanitization, and leather conditioning.
- 7-Seater / Large SUV & Minivans: $150 CAD Flat Rate
  Includes: All 3 rows seat shampooing & stain removal, heavy carpet extraction & salt removal, console, rear controls, trunk area, and complete steam sanitization.
- Pickup Truck (Standard / Work Trucks): $125 CAD Flat Rate
  Includes: Full cab seat shampooing, floor mat & carpet extraction, dashboard, console, door panels, and salt removal.
- Day Cab Truck (Semi-Trucks & Commercial Day Cabs): $140 CAD Flat Rate
  Includes: Full cab seat shampooing, floor & pedal deep clean, dashboard, gauges, controls, door panels, and steam sanitization.
- Sleeper Bed Truck (Semi-Trucks & Long-Haul Rigs): $250 CAD Flat Rate
  Includes: Full cab & sleeper berth shampooing, mattress deep clean & sanitization, dashboard, gauges, storage compartments, curtains, and complete odor elimination.
- Add-On: 99% Pet Hair Extraction: +$20 CAD Flat Rate

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Do you come to my home or workplace?
A: Yes. A-Shine is 100% mobile. We bring commercial-grade steam cleaning tools, extraction equipment, and supplies directly to your location. Studio drop-off at 54 Woodbine Ave, Kitchener is also available.

Q: What utilities do you need at my location?
A: Access to a standard 120V household electrical outlet and an outdoor water faucet. If you live in an apartment or condominium with limited access, please notify us when booking to arrange accommodations or studio drop-off.

Q: How long does interior car detailing take?
A: Small cars take approximately 2–2.5 hours. 5-seater and 7-seater SUVs take 2.5–3.5 hours. Commercial day cabs and sleeper rigs take 3–5 hours.

Q: Can you remove heavy Ontario winter road salt stains?
A: Yes. We use industrial high-heat steam extraction that dissolves hardened salt crust without damaging carpet fibers.

Q: How can I book an appointment?
A: Call or text (519) 729-5856, message via WhatsApp, or submit the free quote form on https://www.a-shineautomobiledetailing.ca/.
